تقاعست (form VI)
# تَقَاعَسْتُ (taqāʕastu) /ta.qaː.ʕas.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَقَاعَسَ (taqāʕasa)
# تَقَاعَسْتَ (taqāʕasta) /ta.qaː.ʕas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَقَاعَسَ (taqāʕasa)
# تَقَاعَسْتِ (taqāʕasti) /ta.qaː.ʕas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَقَاعَسَ (taqāʕasa)
# تَقَاعَسَتْ (taqāʕasat) /ta.qaː.ʕa.sat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
